outcome: Incidence of specific arrhythmia types (atrial flutter/fibrillation, atrioventricular block, lethal arrhythmias)
cohort: Women who gave birth between 2007 and 2015 in Korea (37,297 with PIH, 1,998,387 with normotensive pregnancies)
finding: PIH is significantly associated with an increased risk of developing clinically significant arrhythmia, particularly atrial flutter/fibrillation and atrioventricular block, within one year after delivery.
